build: Release Swift variants sharing the same verified Release Kotlin framework
metricNotes: CPU is app-process CPU time across threads, not utilization.
List readiness is a hierarchy check, not completed rendering.
Both first callback latency and later callback gaps matter.
Trace CPU samples and fixture process CPU are separate measurements.
Hitch contexts and inclusive CPU categories overlap; do not add them into wall-time percentages.
RSS values are checkpoints, not peak/long-session measurements.
Initial controls and rejected production pilots are single-process experiments.
The matched static controls share viewport, insets, visible-cell count and fixed row heights. Production uses automatic sizing.
Final UI-only rebuilds added longer screenshot settling and weak table lifetime checks outside measured resume phases.
Lifecycle timestamps are removed from the sanitized artifact; public traits and callback order are preserved.

decisions.kept: Native UITableView for production Receipt rows, diffable IDs, dynamic sizing; existing model, navigation and Store5 boundary retained.
excluded: Initial table control: viewport mismatch and truncated amount
